picks1.rule: Tier 1 winner-only search: the Win List, or at least 2 of the 5 strongest winner signals (the widest screen) (a 6% fall in the last 5 sessions, 40%+ under the 1-year high, volatility in the top eighth, price under RM1, 6-month gain in the top 20%). Stocks that also lose a lot with the same signals are kept. Tier 2: other checks vote.

picks2.rule: Tier 1, the tight screen: the runner signal (a new 252-day high, 6-month gain in the top 20% of Shariah stocks, close above the 200-day, 50-day above the 200-day; Q-049/Q-050) AND the Minervini Trend Template AND a calm range (ATR 1.2x its 100-day or less). Tier 2: weekly uptrend and the other checks vote.

defs.name: Trend Rider Q
defs.text: New 252-day high, volume 1.5x, MA50 above MA200, calm ATR. The Buy rule itself.

defs.name: TRQ-Y
defs.text: New 252-day high and trailing dividend yield of 6% or more. The Buy rule itself.

defs.name: Win List
defs.text: Research only. Price under RM1, a 6% one-day fall within 5 sessions, 40%+ below the 252-day high, 6-month gain of 39%+. Touched +6% in 45 sessions 81.5% of the time but averaged -1.6% to -5.5% a trade after costs.

defs.name: Minervini Trend Template
defs.text: Close above MA50/150/200, MA50>MA150>MA200, MA200 rising 1 month, 25%+ above the 52-week low, within 25% of the 52-week high.

defs.name: 55-day breakout
defs.text: Close at a new 55-day high (Turtle / Donchian entry).

defs.name: Strength rank
defs.text: 6-month return in the top 30% of all eligible Shariah stocks (relative strength rank).

defs.name: Volume expansion
defs.text: Up day on volume 1.5x the 20-day average with the close above MA50 (O'Neil style).

avoid.name: Avoid List
avoid.text: Research only. ATR 4.5%+ of price, price RM3+, 6% one-day fall within 5 sessions, 6-month gain of 39%+.

checks.rare_text: RARE SETUP - not a pick. A very volatile cheap stock (under RM0.50) at a new 252-day high after a 6% fall within the last 5 days, with a 6-month gain of 39% or more. In the past 8% of such cases rose 300% within a year (normal 0.6%) and 1.5% rose 900% within two years (normal 0.1%). But most lost money: after costs the average trade was -5%, and no exit rule, including a protective stop at the cost-cover level and no profit cap, made the average positive. It appears about 16 times a year, mostly in market crashes and rebounds (2020). Default action: stay in the money-market fund.
